# PraisonAIUI

> A web UI for AI agents in Python: streaming chat, an artifacts canvas, selectable layouts, a dashboard and docs sites.

## Start Here

- [PraisonAIUI](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/index.md): A web UI for AI agents in Python. Streaming chat, an artifacts canvas, selectable layouts, a dashboard and docs sites, from one pip package.
- [Installation](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/getting-started/installation.md): PraisonAIUI is one Python package. The PyPI name is aiui, you import it as
- [Quick Start](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md): Run a chat app, connect it to a model, then try the other UI styles and layouts.
- [UI Styles](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/styles.md): The style decides which frontend serves your app. aiui run picks one from your
- [CLI Usage](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/getting-started/cli.md): The commands you will use most. Every command and option is in the

## Step-by-Step: Agent UI

- [Step 1: Your First Chat App](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/tutorials/first-chat.md): Install PraisonAIUI and launch your first working chat app in two minutes — using either 5 lines of Python or zero-code YAML.
- [Step 2: Connect an AI Model & Stream Replies](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/tutorials/connect-ai.md): Upgrade your chat app with live token-by-token AI streaming and per-conversation memory.
- [Step 3: Welcome Screen, Starters & Profiles](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/tutorials/welcome-and-starters.md): Make your chat inviting with a custom greeting, clickable starter cards and selectable assistant personas.
- [Step 4: Show Agent Reasoning, Steps & Interactive Prompts](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/tutorials/steps-and-tools.md): Make your agent transparent by displaying timed tool steps, asking clarifying questions mid-reply and adding action buttons.
- [Step 5: Rich UI, Notifications & Custom Pages](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/tutorials/rich-ui-and-pages.md): Expand your chat app into a multi-page workspace with metric cards, filterable tables, live bell notifications and selectable layouts.
- [Step 6: Theme, Secure & Deploy Your App](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/tutorials/theme-auth-deploy.md): Add your brand theme, persistent storage, deny-by-default sign-in, health checks and production deployment.

## Step-by-Step: Dashboards, A2UI & Plugins

- [Server pages](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/guides/server-pages.md): Pages built in Python with @aiui.page and aiui blocks - filters in the URL, forms and page actions, lazy tabs, auto refresh and job status.
- [Build a focused app](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/guides/focused-app.md): A dashboard with only your pages, in the new app shell, with its own chat history.
- [Step-by-Step Quickstart](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/a2ui/quickstart.md): Build and run your first interactive A2UI surface in PraisonAIUI step by step.
- [UI Plugins](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/plugins.md): A UI plugin is a Python package that adds pages, blocks, chat tool renderers,

- [Migrating from Gradio](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/guides/from-gradio.md): Side-by-side guide for moving Gradio demos and Chatbot apps to PraisonAIUI.

- [Writing docs pages](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/writing-docs.md): Every block a docs page can use, with its Markdown and a live example, and the look the site draws them in.

## Core Concepts

- [Agent UI Overview](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/chat-ui/overview.md): Build streaming AI agent interfaces in minutes with Python decorators or zero-code YAML.
- [Chat Lifecycle](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/chat-ui/lifecycle.md): Understand every moment in a chat session — from the opening greeting to streaming replies, stopping and clean-up.
- [Messages, Streaming & Interactions](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/chat-ui/messages-and-streaming.md): Send complete replies, stream tokens live, ask the user follow-up questions, attach media and trigger clickable buttons.
- [Starters, Profiles & Author Names](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/chat-ui/starters-and-profiles.md): Help users start fast with clickable prompt suggestions, switchable assistant personas and friendly display names.
- [Steps](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/steps.md): A step is a named piece of work inside a reply: a tool call, an LLM call, a
- [Session Management](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/sessions.md): PraisonAIUI provides full session management for chat conversations — create, switch, view history, and delete sessions.
- [Handler context](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/handler-context.md): Inside an @aiui.reply (or @aiui.on_message) handler you can ask who is calling, keep state for

## Canvas & Rich Media

- [A2UI canvas — agent-driven UI](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/a2ui-canvas.md): PraisonAIUI hosts A2UI (v0.8, v0.9, and v0.10) surfaces: agents push structured UI messages to a live canvas while users chat in the same window or on a full-pa
- [Message Elements](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/message-elements.md): A message can carry elements: images, PDFs, videos, audio, files and code
- [Chat Attachments](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/attachments.md): Upload a file, then send a chat message with its id: PDFs and text files are
- [Image Preview in Chat](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/image-preview-chat.md): Protocol-driven inline media for agent-generated images (and other element types) during chat streaming. Any backend that implements BaseProvider can emit image
- [Media Analysis](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/media-analysis.md): The media analysis feature uses the VisionAgent and OCRAgent from the PraisonAI SDK when available. Without the SDK, it returns simulated responses to allow fro

## Agents, Tools & Voice

- [Gateway Chat](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/gateway-chat.md): The Chat page of the dashboard style (and of the app shell, which hosts the same view): real-time agent chat over a WebSocket, with markdown rendering, tool cal
- [Human-in-the-Loop Approvals](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/approvals.md): Require explicit human approval before agents run sensitive tools, with inline chat cards, a dedicated Approvals queue and SSE updates.
- [Pre/Post Operation Hooks](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/hooks.md): HooksFeature (builtin.hooks) exposes pre- and post-operation hooks over REST and the CLI, merging hooks defined in praisonaiagents.hooks (SDK hooks) with hooks
- [Subagent Tree View](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/subagent-tree.md): Visualize agent hierarchies — see which agents spawn subagents, track their status, and monitor the full execution tree.
- [Code Execution](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/code-execution.md): 1. Code is submitted with a target language. A language outside the allowlist (default: python, javascript, bash) is a 400; so is any language other than Python
- [Model Fallback](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/model-fallback.md): The model fallback feature (praisonaiui.features.model_fallback) lists the
- [MCP servers](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/mcp.md): Give your agents the tools of any Model Context Protocol server, declared in YAML, over Streamable HTTP, SSE or stdio, with secrets kept on the server
- [Text-to-Speech (TTS)](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/tts.md): Synthesize speech from text using swappable backends — browser-native (zero cost) or OpenAI TTS API.
- [Voice input in the chat](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/realtime-voice-input.md): Talk instead of typing. When an app turns on voice input, the chat composer

## Integrations

- [Providers](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/concepts/providers.md): PraisonAIUI uses a provider protocol — a simple abstraction that lets you plug in any AI backend.
- [PraisonAI package integration](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/praisonai-package-integration.md): How PraisonAIUI (aiui) connects to praisonai-package — the agent runtime, gateway, and CLI. For generic UI hosting see Agent UI host.
- [Standalone vs Integrated](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/standalone-vs-integrated.md): This page summarises the expected install and runtime shape for PraisonAIUI in both modes.
- [Backend Integration Contract](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/backend-integration.md): PraisonAIUI supports a four-layer integration model so standalone mode and SDK-integrated mode can share the same feature APIs.
- [Workflows, Hooks & OpenAI-Compatible API](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/workflows-and-openai-api.md): Orchestrate multi-step agent workflows, trigger server lifecycle hooks and call your agents over an OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint.
- [AG-UI Protocol](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/agui.md): PraisonAIUI exposes an AG-UI SSE endpoint (POST /agui) so CopilotKit and any AG-UI-compatible frontend can stream runs directly from your PraisonAI agents.

- [Theme System](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/theme-system.md): The theme feature (praisonaiui.features.theme) holds the dashboard's colour

## Overview

- [UI Components Overview](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/overview.md): Browse all 81 Python and zero-code YAML UI components plus the built-in Notification Center.
- [Layout & Navigation Components](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/layout.md): Arrange pages with grids, cards, tabs, accordions, split list-details, kanban boards, breadcrumbs and SPA page links.
- [Data Display & Charts](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/data-display.md): Display KPIs, sparklines, sortable searchable tables, 10 interactive chart types, badges, progress bars, code and JSON.
- [Inputs, Filters & Forms](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/inputs-and-forms.md): Build URL-synced filter bars, interactive POST forms, selects, multi-selects, date ranges, sliders, switches and action buttons.
- [Feedback, Overlays & Notifications](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/feedback-and-notifications.md): Show alerts, job progress, loading skeletons, modal dialogs, toasts and real-time header Notification Center alerts.
- [Media, Markdown & Content Components](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/media-and-content.md): Render rich text, Markdown documents with auto TOC, images, responsive galleries, audio/video players and safe embeds.

## Layout & Navigation

- [Card & Card Grid](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/card.md): Display headline values or responsive grids of entity cards in Python or YAML.
- [Columns, Container & Layout](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/columns.md): Compose responsive multi-column grids, titled sections, and auto-refreshing page layouts.
- [Chat Panel](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/chat-panel.md): Composable embedded Agent Chat panel for split-pane workspaces beside tables, charts, or documents.
- [Tabs](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/tabs.md): Switch between panels of components with keyboard navigation and optional lazy loading.
- [Accordion & Expander](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/accordion.md): Progressive disclosure panels for FAQs, nested settings, and optional lazy sections.
- [Stepper](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/stepper.md): Show multi-step workflow, onboarding, or pipeline progress horizontally or vertically.
- [Header, Divider & Separator](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/header-and-divider.md): Section headings and horizontal rules to structure complex app pages.
- [Breadcrumb](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/breadcrumb.md): Hierarchical navigation trail showing the user's location across nested pages.
- [Pagination](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/pagination.md): Interactive page navigation controls for server-paginated lists and tables.
- [Links & Page Navigation](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/links.md): Inline links, button-styled links, and SPA page links with query parameters.

## Data Display

- [Metric & Stat Group](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/metric.md): KPI cards with trend deltas, inline sparklines, benchmarks, and stat grids.
- [Data Table](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/table.md): Sortable, searchable, paginated data table with typed columns, badges, and row details.
- [Interactive Spreadsheet](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/sheet.md): Multi-tab interactive spreadsheet with live zero-eval formulas (=SUM, =AVERAGE, =IF), cell editing, row filtering, and CSV/JSON export.
- [Interactive Whiteboard](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/whiteboard.md): Draggable whiteboard canvas with stickies, shapes, groups, live-tracking arrows, zoom, fullscreen modal, and SVG/JSON export.
- [Chart](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/chart.md): Interactive Recharts visualizations across 10 chart kinds with theme colors and tooltips.
- [Board](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/board.md): Kanban-style column board for tracking agent tasks, tickets, and workflow stages.
- [Timeline](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/timeline.md): Chronological activity feed and audit trail with status-colored markers and timestamps.
- [Diff Viewer](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/diff-viewer.md): Unified line-by-line diff viewer for comparing prompts, YAML configs, or generated code.
- [Tree View](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/tree-view.md): Collapsible hierarchical tree for file browsers, RAG sources, and nested agent graphs.
- [List Detail](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/list-detail.md): Searchable master-detail table with an interactive side inspector panel.
- [Definition List](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/definition-list.md): Clean label-and-value summary list for metadata, environment specs, and inspection panels.
- [Badge & Status](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/badge.md): Compact inline labels and live job status rows with state icons, progress, and log tails.
- [Avatar](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/avatar.md): User or agent avatar with automatic initials fallback and responsive sizes.
- [Gallery](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/gallery.md): Responsive media and artifact gallery grid with titles, captions, tags, and links.

## Inputs & Forms

- [Form](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/form.md): Interactive form container that collects input values and submits to your page action handler.
- [Filter Bar](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/filter-bar.md): Compact inline filter bar with instant updates, active filter chips, and one-click reset.
- [Text & Textarea Input](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/text-input.md): Single-line text fields and multi-line textareas for prompts, names, and notes.
- [Number Input](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/number-input.md): Numeric field with min/max bounds and step increments for budgets, tokens, and limits.
- [Select Input](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/select-input.md): Dropdown selector with optional client search and remote async option loading.
- [Multiselect & Tags Input](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/multiselect-and-tags.md): Multi-choice chip selector and free-text tag input for tools, labels, and filters.
- [Slider Input](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/slider-input.md): Range slider for tuning temperatures, top-p thresholds, and numeric weights.
- [Checkbox & Switch Input](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/checkbox-and-switch.md): Boolean toggles and checkboxes for feature flags, streaming options, and preferences.
- [Radio & Segmented Input](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/radio-and-segmented.md): Mutually exclusive radio groups and compact toggle pill bars for quick mode switching.
- [Date, Time & Date Range](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/date-and-time.md): Native date, time, and preset-powered date range pickers for schedules and analytics.
- [Color Picker & Rating Input](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/color-and-rating.md): Theme color swatch picker and accessible interactive star rating control.
- [File Upload](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/file-upload.md): Drag-and-drop file uploader backed by the authenticated /api/chat/attachments endpoint with safe server-side resolution.
- [Button Group](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/button-group.md): Action button bar that dispatches named events to your Python page action handler.

## Feedback & Overlays

- [Alert & Callout](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/alert-and-callout.md): Contextual banners and Markdown-enabled callout boxes for status, warnings, and tips.
- [Progress Bar](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/progress-bar.md): Determinate progress indicator for indexing jobs, batch runs, and quota meters.
- [Spinner & Skeleton](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/spinner-and-skeleton.md): Indeterminate loading spinners and layout-preserving skeleton placeholders.
- [Empty State](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/empty-state.md): Clean placeholder when a table, search filter, or workspace has no records yet.
- [Dialog](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/dialog.md): Accessible modal dialog overlay triggered by a button for confirmations and nested forms.
- [Popover, Tooltip & Toast](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/popover-and-tooltip.md): Anchored click popovers, hover tooltips, and transient toast notifications.

## Media & Content

- [Text, Caption & Markdown](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/text-and-markdown.md): Body copy, muted captions, and sanitized Markdown content blocks with GFM support.
- [Doc Viewer](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/components/doc-viewer.md): Long-form Markdown document viewer with automatic heading extraction and sticky TOC.

## API Docs, SEO & Auth

- [OpenAPI](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/openapi.md): Point the docs site at an OpenAPI spec; aiui build loads, bundles and checks it.
- [Python API reference](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/api-reference-python.md): One line in a docs page and aiui build writes the reference for a Python module, class or function from its docstrings.
- [SEO](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/seo.md): Built-in SEO for documentation sites — sitemap, robots, llms.txt, per-page meta tags, and crawlable static HTML.
- [Redirects and the not-found page](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/redirects.md): Move or rename a page without breaking the links people already have, and
- [AI-ready docs](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/ai-ready-docs.md): Every page as clean Markdown for agents, llms.txt by nav group, llms-full.txt, agent instructions, Visibility, Accept text/markdown, an MCP server and Ask AI with cited answers.
- [Analytics, support chat and cookie consent](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/analytics.md): Add web analytics or a support chat widget to a docs site with one line per
- [Docs sign-in](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/docs-auth.md): Put a docs site behind a password, keep some pages open to everyone, and limit
- [Content Security Policy](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/content-security-policy.md): A docs site built with aiui build ships with a strict Content-Security-Policy

## Protocols

- [Feature Protocols](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/protocols.md): PraisonAIUI uses a protocol-driven architecture to wire features into the server. Every feature module implements the BaseFeatureProtocol ABC, which auto-regist
- [Protocol Architecture Reference](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/protocol-architecture.md): All feature modules in PraisonAIUI implement a Protocol ABC pattern for type-safe, swappable backends.
- [Protocol Versioning](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/features/protocol-versioning.md): The protocol uses semantic versioning — clients and servers are compatible if they share the same major version:
- [Application Design Protocol (ADP)](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/protocols/adp.md): Declarative UI design standard for describing application layout, navigation, components, and theming from YAML or JSON manifests.
- [Application Design Protocol (ADP) — Normative Specification](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/protocols/adp/spec.md): This document uses RFC 2119 keywords: MUST, MUST NOT, SHOULD, MAY.
- [ADP Validation Rules](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/protocols/adp/validation-rules.md): Cross-reference validation rules for Application Design Protocol manifests. These constraints cannot be expressed in JSON Schema alone and MUST be enforced by c
- [PraisonAIUI → ADP Field Mapping](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/protocols/adp/aiui-mapping.md): Field-by-field mapping from current aiui.yaml (Config model in src/praisonaiui/schema/models.py) to ADP Application spec.
- [ADP Implementation Status](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/protocols/adp/implementation-status.md): Honest status of ADP v1alpha1 features against the PraisonAIUI reference implementation.
- [Application Design Protocol (ADP) — Research Report](https://ui.praison.ai/docs/protocols/application-design-protocol-report.md): There is no single existing standard for designing full application UI from a declarative text file. Instead, the problem is addressed in fragments:
